A song that fails goes back to the pack. https://gen.daydream.live/docs#packs

Resubmit the request after completing payment to receive an access_token. Use the returned token as Bearer authentication for POST /songs to generate songs. Failed song generations return credits to the pack. Requires no initial authentication.

data.current_description: Puts the song in line and returns it at once, status queued. Poll GET /songs/{id} every 2 seconds until status is done or failed. Counts one song against the month (given back if it fails). Or, with no key, pay 0.05 USD for it over HTTP 402: the 402 offers MPP (WWW-Authenticate: Payment, USDC on Tempo or Base) and x402 (PAYMENT-REQUIRED, USDC on Base); send the request again with the payment, and the song comes back with an access_token to poll it with. A paid song that fails is refunded. https://gen.daydream.live/docs#pay
data.description_suggestion: Creates a new song generation job from a text description. Returns immediately with status 'queued' and a song ID. Poll GET /songs/{id} every 2 seconds to check generation progress (status: 'processing', 'done', or 'failed'). Authenticated requests consume one monthly song credit (refunded if generation fails). Unauthenticated requests require HTTP 402 payment (0.05 USD via USDC on Tempo or Base). Include payment details in the Authorization header and retry the request to complete payment. Paid songs that fail are automatically refunded.

data.current_description: `redo`: this stem made again with the other four exactly as they are; counts as one song; poll the song until its version's `redo.making` is gone (about a minute), then the version plays the new stem and the mix made with it. `undo`: the version back to how it was before its last redo, free; only the last redo can be undone.

Both actions require authentication.

data.current_description: Puts the song in line and returns it at once, status queued. Poll GET /songs/{id} every 2 seconds until status is done or failed. A paid song that fails is refunded. https://gen.daydream.live/docs#pay
data.description_suggestion: Creates a new song generation job from a text description. Returns immediately with status 'queued' and a song ID. Unauthenticated requests require HTTP 402 payment (0.05 USD via USDC on Tempo or Base). Include payment details in the Authorization header and retry the request to complete payment. Paid songs that fail are automatically refunded.
